licence.scope: LROC Terms of Use & Citation Policy (level 2, owner's terms; the LROC team at Arizona State University). The statement covers LROC images and PDS data products; it does not name filter response curves. Classed permission because the SVO curve is not shown to be a PDS product; if it is, the PDS data are public domain. Source cited by SVO: Robinson et al. 2010 (https://ui.adsabs.harvard.edu/abs/2010SSRv..150...81R). The curves are SVO Filter Profile Service records recovered from Internet Archive captures (svo2.cab.inta-csic.es did not answer on 2026-10-26); SVO states no licence (page footer '© SVO') and asks for the acknowledgement listed in info.json.
